name: CI on: [push, pull_request] jobs: test: runs-on: ubuntu-latest strategy: matrix: python-version: ['3.10', '3.11', '3.12'] steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-python@v6 with: python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }} - run: pip install "pytest>=7.0.0" - run: pytest --junitxml=report.xml - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 if: always() with: name: test-report-${{ matrix.python-version }} path: report.xml
